outcome: Overall coagulation potential (fibrin generation) on OHP
cohort: 60 women undergoing term elective caesarean delivery and 47 healthy non-pregnant women aged 18-45 years
finding: Global coagulation assays (GCAs) reliably detect the physiological hypercoagulability of pregnancy, and thromboelastography (TEG) appears to correlate with obesity in the pregnant population.
